description: Read one cited company profile by domain or by company name: name, description, HQ, founded year, industry, employee band, social links, a funding rollup (the amount raised across the rounds we hold, not lifetime total raised) and a careers link, with a source URL on every field and each marked `stated` (a page states it) or `inferred` (classified from a page); a field no source supports is null, never guessed. Costs $0.02 per company returned, drawn from your balance. A domain not built yet returns 202 `building` (retry in about 30 seconds), and a domain that does not resolve to a company returns 404; both are free. A company name is matched whole against the funding rounds we hold: several companies with that name answer HTTP 300 with each `{name, domain}` to choose from (free, never a guess), and no company with that name is a free 404.

domain.description: The company's domain, for example `acme.com`, or its exact name, for example `Acme Robotics`.

name: company_get
title: Get Company Profile
